title: Disclosure and Mitigation of Gender Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Indirect probing via conditional generation using naturally-sourced, LLM-generated, and template-based prompts. Bias is evaluated using an explicit metric (Gender Attribute Score, which checks for the presence of gendered pronouns in generated text) and implicit metrics (Gender Logits Difference and Attribute Distribution Distance, which measure the probability and distribution shifts between male and female attribute words).
